text:
maria: Late heads-up — demo tomorrow 09:00 UTC needs ~8 A100s in asia-southeast1 for a 3-hour window. Can we borrow from standby or swap with eu pool? cc @jon @tara
jon: Thx. What's the node type you need? a100-80gb or a100-40?
maria: a100-40 preferred. lower thermal risk. If we can't get APAC, we can run in eu-west1 but that adds ~80ms to latency (not ideal for live demo).
ops-andy: I can try a short swap. Two quick checks: current quota in asia, and whether reserved eu pool has headroom. Running quota check now.
vendor-bot: Capacity snapshot: asia-southeast1 available A100-40 = 4, eu-west1 available A100-40 = 12 (subject to current reservations).
jon: Ok looks tight. Can we bump asia by borrowing 4 from eu and re-routing ephemeral jobs? We'll need a terraform tag + billing center to reassign.
maria: Can you drop the terraform snippet? I'll file a quick PR.
jon: Snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "demo-swap" {
  region = "asia-southeast1"
  gpu_type = "A100-40"
  tags = ["nightshift-demo", "temp-borrow"]
  override_source = "eu-west1"
}
```
Also add `billing_center = "demo-team"` so finance can track.
tara: Billing FYI: temp borrow will be charged to demo-team unless ops approves transfer. I can approve if scope < 4 hours. :ok_hand:
ops-andy: I've opened quick PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/PR-3224 — includes tag + canary rollback. If everyone +1, I'll apply and run swap job.
maria: Link looks good. Can we also add auto-fallback to eu if spot rate spikes? small script in the deploy.
jon: Agree. Add this check to the swap job:
```bash
# quick headroom check
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-infra | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```
vendor-bot: Reminder: vendor maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC in eu-west1, might affect headroom.
ops-andy: Noted. We'll schedule swap to start at 05:00 UTC so it's after maintenance and gives time for PR merge.
tara: :thumbsup: I'll greenlight billing for up to 4 hours.
maria: Thanks all. If swap goes through I'll post final confirmation here. Will ping oncall if anything noisy.
jon: If anything blocks, ping me and I'll escalate with vendor.
ops-andy: applying labels + running canary at 04:50 UTC, will report back status here.
maria: received — much appreciated. :rocket:
